adc_driver.load_caveat: ADC input430ohm typ is not a guaranteed ideal broadband resistor.36ohm source resistors and sampled-input effects alter gain; do not claim exact fullscale from this simplified gain.

aux_load.hiz_pair: AUX_BUF_P=+Tip;AUX_HIZ_INV=-Tip, so differential2*Tip before AUX driver

pga_input_0db_check.caveat: typical DC offset and simplified symmetric sine are not guaranteed operating envelope

open_engineering_checks: This plan is not manufacture release. Exact relay/connector physical contact pads and coil polarity still require selected mechanical datasheets.

ADC driver output swing/settling into sampled input and36ohm+100pF network requires simulation/measurement; preserve2Vrms differential nominal test budget rather than claiming full3.2Vrms low-distortion.
PGA MCU signals must not backpower unpoweredAFE; digital interface buffer/sequence implementation remains digital-page responsibility.
PGA input surge clamp requires actual >=10A surge diode qualification and a rail-clamp/absorption path; generic Schottky label alone is not signoff.
DAC source-resistor mismatch and amplifier offsets create residual DC. Verify DC offset before headphone relay closes; independentDC-fault cutoff circuit is not yet designed.
TPA feedback capacitor forbidden. Verify stability with actual headphone cable/open-circuit/high-Z load;39.2ohm is retained as conservative TI reference.
K3/K4 must be held off by hardware on power fault, not onlyMCU software; power-good gating and relay coil drivers are external control/power plan.
Effective capacitance/leakage/ESR and exact control-register sequence require completion beforePCB release. No inventory/pricing or purchase work was done.
TPA unpowered inputs require hardware isolation/clamp to <600mV; K4 output relay alone insufficient
Relay supply must be separately budgeted and pickup-qualified at minimum available voltage; not onAFE LDO

findings: AFE current headroom must include93mA positive/95mA negative full-temperature static budget
350mA positiveRAW prior allocation does not cover514mA sum of prior downstream allocations
TPS7A39 total accuracy includes internal reference/buffer/load/line/process/temp; do not double-count them, but add external resistor/current-error budget
Phantom clamp injection requires rail energy absorption, not just LDO reverse-current diodes
TPA unpowered input peak must remain below600mV; output relays alone do not ensure this
Relay5V pickup at V5_SYS minimum3.8V not established; separate coil supply/load budget required
Full ADC3.2Vrms swing into sampled430ohm load not guaranteed fromOPA1612 2kohm output table
MCLK-BCLK phase budget must include translator skew and PCB delay
